lines.en: I move like a shadow sliding.

lines.zh: 我的脚不碰地，却留下印子。
lines.en: My feet do not touch, yet they leave prints.

lines.zh: 白衣往下垂，一路扫过地。
lines.en: My white cloth drags along the floor.
I raise a hand like a puppeteer.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方灯光发暗。
lines.en: The lights dim where I pass.
I go down the hall very slowly.
My joints hang as if on strings.
There's no expression on my face.

lines.zh: 每一步都有一点声音，不多。
lines.en: A little sound per step. No more.
I dare not hurry. I would come apart.
I walk a stretch behind you.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，影子多了。
lines.en: More shadows remain where I have passed.
My fingers are very long.

lines.zh: 这间屋子的门总是关着。
lines.en: The door to this room is always shut.
I count the nights remaining.
A stain on my white cloth.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛只是两个黑洞。
lines.en: My eyes are two dark holes.
I wait for the clock.
There is no one in this room.

lines.zh: 我伸出手，什么也没碰到。
lines.en: I reach out and touch nothing.
A shadow stirs in the corner.
You should close your eyes.
I will stand here a moment.
That light in your hand is harsh.
My face is painted.
You need not run.
I am behind you as well.
I have counted your breaths.
Do not speak.
Can you still hear me?
I feel no pain, yet I recoil.
A tear in my white cloth.
I list to one side.

lines.zh: 线被扯断一根，我歪向一边。
lines.en: A string snaps; I tilt to one side.
I drift half a block and stop.
The strings are near snapping.
I make no sound.

lines.zh: 面具裂了，里面还是黑的。
lines.en: My mask cracks; the inside is black too.
You did strike me after all.
I do not need to eat.

lines.zh: 这个东西对我不算什么。
lines.en: That means little to me.
Leave the food on the floor.
It will go cold soon.
I am not hungry, but people are.
Take it away.
I have no mouth to use.

lines.zh: 我没有嘴，食物收回去吧。
lines.en: I have no mouth. Take the food back.
I reach out, then withdraw.
I look at it, and keep looking.
You passed through me.
I have no bones to collide with.
I drift half a block aside.
Your skin has gone to gooseflesh.
I am nearly immovable.

lines.zh: 你穿过我的线，我停住了。
lines.en: You pass through my strings; I freeze.
A cold spot on the back of my hand.
We did not truly touch.
I have given way.
Try it once more.
I am not a living thing.
Such things are meaningless.
I can only stand and watch.
You cannot touch me.

lines.zh: 我戴着一张脸，不是我的。
lines.en: I wear a face that is not mine.
Say no more.

lines.zh: 线缠在一起，不需要伴侣。
lines.en: My strings tangle together; I need no mate.
My mask is black on white.
I reach; it floats up.
It passes from your hand to me.
I do not need it, but I want it.
It has gone cold.
A shadow on the floor reaches for it.
I lift it and set it down.
This is yours, is it not?
It is mine now.
You struck, so that's the start.
I will remember this.
I have no anger, only memory.
You are on my list now.
Do not think I cannot hurt you.
One step is enough.
The lights are already out.
You are remembered.

lines.zh: 乐声一停，我的头就转向你。
lines.en: The music stops, and my head turns to you.
I want your breathing.
Forty points of damage — enough?
Look at my face.
The music box stops; I lift my head.
I drift behind you.
Walls do not stop me.

lines.zh: 光扫过来，我的影子不退。
lines.en: Your light sweeps over; my shadow does not retreat.
You retreat, but not far.
My fingers already reach you.

lines.zh: 你听到的是自己的心跳。
lines.en: What you hear is your own heart.
It grows darker here.
You count doors. There are fewer.
I stay at the edge of your sight.
When you turn, I am not there.
I am right here.

lines.zh: 白面具后面，我数到第三下。
lines.en: Behind the white mask, I count your third breath.
One more step.
I see your hand feeling for a way.
Do not look back.
I am everywhere you have walked.

lines.zh: 黑线从天花板垂到你肩后。
lines.en: A black string drops from the ceiling behind you.
My hand passes into your shoulder.
I grab your breath.

lines.zh: 黑线收紧，你连喊都来不及。
lines.en: The strings tighten before you can shout.
You are thrown against the wall.
My fingers find your neck.
You cannot block any of it.
I close my grip.

lines.zh: 你的护甲在这里没有用。
lines.en: Armor is useless here.
Gently is enough to hurt.
I let you go.
You drop to the floor.
Do not get up.
I raise a hand; you are thrown again.
That was heavier than the last.
Your blood is warm. Good.
You may sleep now.
I press you back to the floor.
You cannot hear this one coming.

lines.zh: 我的长指扣住你的肋骨。
lines.en: My long fingers close on your ribs.

lines.zh: 你退开的每一步我都跟着。
lines.en: Every step you take back, I follow.
The lights went out. I am here.
It was always me behind the door.
I stand in the corner of the room.
Did you hear the chime?
There is one more shadow on the floor.

lines.zh: 我没有走进来，我本来就在。
lines.en: I did not walk in. I was already here.
The air has gone cold.
You should replace that torch.
I raise my hands, slowly.
The frame on that wall is empty.
My face is black and white stripes.

lines.zh: 火照出我的轮廓，很难看。
lines.en: Fire shows my outline. It is ugly.
I fall without a sound.

lines.zh: 水淹没了我，我还在往下看。
lines.en: Water covers me; I keep looking down.
The light whited out the whole room.

lines.zh: 那东西从我身上穿过去了。
lines.en: It passed through me.
That light recognized me.

lines.zh: 雷光里我的影子拉得很长。
lines.en: Lightning stretches my shadow long.
This is where I belong.
